read.thesis: Dow's Q3 EBITDA of $1.553B and Q4 guide of about $1.5B rest on PE price hikes (7c Oct, 5c Nov) and self-help, while Europe closures and Middle East constraints remain; Q4 margin uplift is only 2c/lb.

utilisation.quote: operating rates today are in the low eighties

capex.peers_comment: Management said about 10% of industry ethylene capacity needs to exit to return to mid-cycle; 5-6% already announced, including Dow's Europe cracker; around 8% more speculated, mostly high-cost regions.
capex.quote: you needed about 10% of capacity to come out in order to materially get back to mid cycle operating rates

triggers.label: Industry capacity exits 5-6% announced
triggers.quote: 5 to 6% of that has already been announced, and that includes our cracker in Europe

triggers.label: PE operating rates low eighties
triggers.quote: operating rates today are in the low eighties

triggers.label: PE hikes 7c Oct, 5c Nov
triggers.quote: 7 cents per pound in October and then another 5 cents in November

triggers.label: US PE inventory down over 400M lbs
triggers.quote: Inventory declined by over 400 million pounds

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA ~ $1.5B, flat sequentially
triggers.quote: For the fourth quarter, we expect EBITDA of approximately $1.5 billion

guidance.quote: For the fourth quarter, we expect EBITDA of approximately $1.5 billion
we expect to deliver approximately $700 million this year which is higher than our initial projections
our expectation is that our tailwind purely on self help deliver about $1.3 billion in 2027
a more than $500 million cash release in the second half of this year
gonna give us a cash conversion rate that is gonna be in the range of anywhere from, let's say, 70% to 80%
expected to retire approximately $1.4 billion of debt

red_flags.label: Q4 guide relies on price hikes and China recovery
red_flags.quote: Spot prices are also on the rise. So we expect that we are gonna end the fourth quarter with momentum going into 2027.

red_flags.label: Sadara funding and Aramco negotiation unresolved
red_flags.quote: we have established a financial boundary around Sadara. And we are working diligently to identify the best long term solution.

red_flags.label: Europe energy costs and Rhine disruption
red_flags.quote: In Europe, persistently high energy costs continue to challenge industry economics.
